items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: played in a fellow by the name of Watkins -- he owned a theater there. And I went there and took over the leadership of the band there.

ctx.x: And when he said that -- as soon as he said, "please don't knock," I got to say ra-da-da-da- -- that was something. So, I left that show for a while. I stayed there for awhile and I left them and went to Durham -- back to Durham and played in a fellow by the name of Watkins -- he owned a theater there. And I went there and took over the leadership of the band there.
